ValidationRule.description: This validation rule checks that the Reason Lost field is populated before the Opportunity Stage is changed to "Closed Lost".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ) , ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed Lost') , ISBLANK( TEXT( PMC_SS_ReasonLost__c ) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please indicate the reason why this opportunity was lost in the field “Reason Lost”
